- [USER] User asked for more information about the living conditions on Santa Cruz del Islote and how the population is sustained on such a small island.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Santa Cruz del Islote is located in the Archipelago of San Bernardo, off the coast of Colombia.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The island has an estimated population of around 1,200 people living on just 1.2 acres of land.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Living conditions on the island are very basic, lacking infrastructure such as paved roads, sewage systems, and access to clean water.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Most houses on the island are constructed using wood with metal roofs and are built very close to each other.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The island has only one store and one school; residents must travel off-island for basic commodities like medication and supplies.
